tagline: Serving devotees and preserving sacred traditions
intro: Shree Temple Trust is a registered public charitable trust that maintains and serves a group of temples. The Trust looks after daily worship, festival celebrations, temple upkeep, and a range of community services supported entirely by the devotion and generosity of its devotees.

contact.address: Trust Office, Main Road, City, State 000000

donation.taxNote: Donations to the Trust are eligible for deduction under Section 80G of the Income Tax Act. A receipt is issued for every contribution.

temples.name: Shree Mahadev Mandir
temples.summary: The oldest temple under the Trust, known for its Mahashivratri celebrations and the daily Rudrabhishek.
temples.description: Shree Mahadev Mandir is the founding temple of the Trust. The sanctum houses a self-manifested Shivalinga, and the temple has been a place of continuous worship for generations. The courtyard hosts the annual Mahashivratri night-long vigil, attended by thousands of devotees.
temples.addressLine: Temple Street, Old Town, City, State 000000

temples.name: Shree Radha Krishna Mandir
temples.summary: A temple known for its bhajan sandhya every Thursday and the Janmashtami midnight celebration.
temples.description: Built on land donated to the Trust, Shree Radha Krishna Mandir is the centre of the Trust's devotional music tradition. The temple's marble idols of Radha and Krishna are adorned daily with fresh garlands, and the weekly bhajan sandhya has been held without a break for over four decades.

temples.name: Shree Durga Mandir
temples.summary: Set on a hill slope, this temple draws large gatherings through both Navratri seasons.
temples.description: Shree Durga Mandir sits on a quiet hill slope approached by a flight of stone steps. The temple is busiest during Chaitra and Sharad Navratri, when the Trust organises nine days of continuous worship, garba in the courtyard, and free meals for all visitors.

temples.name: Shree Hanuman Mandir
temples.summary: The newest temple of the Trust, with Sundarkand recitation every Tuesday and Saturday.
temples.description: Shree Hanuman Mandir was consecrated in 2004 to serve devotees in the heart of the market area. Despite its compact size, the temple runs a busy schedule of Sundarkand recitations, Hanuman Chalisa paths, and a daily free water and prasad counter for passers-by.

events.name: Kartik Purnima Deepdaan
events.details: Lamp offering at the temple tank from 5:00 PM, followed by Maha Aarti at 6:30 PM.

events.name: Govardhan Puja
events.details: Annakut offering and darshan through the day. Prasad distribution from 12:00 PM.

events.name: Weekly Bhajan Sandhya
events.details: Devotional singing from 7:00 PM to 9:00 PM. Open to all; devotees may request bhajans.

events.name: Sundarkand Path
events.details: Recitation begins at 6:00 PM. Sponsorship available through the Trust office.

events.name: Mahashivratri
events.details: Night-long vigil with four prahar pujas, continuous Rudrabhishek, and Annadanam.

services.title: Annadanam
services.text: Free meals served at the temple premises on festival days and every Sunday.

services.title: Vedic Education
services.text: Evening classes in Sanskrit shlokas, stotras, and traditional ritual for children and adults.

services.title: Medical Camps
services.text: Quarterly free health check-up and eye care camps organised with visiting doctors.

services.title: Temple Conservation
services.text: Ongoing repair and restoration of temple structures, idols, and ritual articles.
